title: Sugar Magnolia | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool And Gulf Views- Sugar Magnolia By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sugar Magnolia of Grayton by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 120 Magnolia Street Details: Located in idyllic Grayton Beach, Sugar Magnolia, offers the perfect setting for your vacation. This favorite little beach town is filled with walkable roads shaded by southern magnolias, moss-draped oaks, and towering pines. The peaceful and private west side location is just steps or a bike ride away from several beach accesses, shops, restaurants and entertainment. The home was constructed with great attention to every detail and amenities abound. Once inside, you are surrounded by luxury furnishings, beautiful shiplap walls and hardwood floors/tile throughout. The home boasts 3 levels with two living areas, a separate office, 2 laundry rooms and 6 bedrooms including 2 master suites; each on the 1st and 2nd floor. Outside, enjoy the outdoor living space, complete with a screened-in porch, private pool, charcoal grill, dining and lounging area. Whether cooking in the gourmet kitchen with its beautiful marble countertops, stainless appliances and gas stove or enjoying a bar-b-que around the pool, this home will make you feel right at home. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 310 Yards -Parking Spaces: 5 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 6 and Bar Seating for 5 -Keurig available -Charcoal Grill Available -Outdoor Shower - Porches on every level - Firepit - Gulf Views -Private Heated Pool: 16’ x 30’ *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater requires 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 18 6 Beds / 4 Full Baths, 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Half Bath -Living Room / Dining Room / Kitchen -Private Office -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bedroom with Jack & Jill Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3: 2 Full Sized Beds with Jack & Jill Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): Full over Full Bunk (access across hall to Full Bath with separate Shower) -Bedroom 5 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 6: (Bunk Room) Full over Full Bunk (access across hall to Full Bath with separate Shower) -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Game Room with TV, Air Hockey Table -Deck with Gulf Views -1/2 Bath Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
